test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 28 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbfbfb178203055405644832332df082ae837d242cf003e285a4075ade62b450.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The bottom element and the last two of elements of the 2nd row from the left shift anticlockwise subsequently.

The rest of the elements shift clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fbfd5d9eeb1b0cddfe945a7cb2e5c2bec7e128c9a8a160ff50ee6c4ae0a26a3.png] 

2) Second box series →

The 1st row elements shift clockwise subsequently.

The 2nd row elements shift clockwise subsequently.

No change in the bottom element.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f9797bc57ac1b05bd652dad42c4ff78c0d970accc86fae54bb8398b6c0f91b9.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86b9cddd0f062f29c3fef97ab6fcf1d8d3fcc041b97c61fb0e33451e369a97ee.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
